description: Visually inspected publisher item pages with adapted, independently solved questions. Collection year and position do not authenticate an original UTME sitting, official key, or exam-board licence.

records.adapted_prompt: Triangle PQR has PQ=QR=8 cm and angle QPR=60°. What is the area of the triangle?
records.source_repair: The source asks for the area of an angle and repeats an incorrect distractor. The adapted prompt asks for triangle area with distinct choices.

records.adapted_prompt: In how many ways can a committee of five be selected from seven men and three women if it must contain exactly one woman?
records.source_repair: The source says 'one female', which could mean exactly one or at least one. The adapted prompt specifies exactly one.

records.adapted_prompt: Let θ be an acute angle with tan θ=8/15. Evaluate (sin θ−cos θ)/(sin² θ−sin θ).
records.source_repair: The source omits the quadrant; positive tangent alone also permits a third-quadrant value. The adapted prompt specifies an acute angle.
